Résumé de recherche et limites

National policy covers UAE government digital services and specified service providers and contractors. Official technical annex references WCAG 2.1 Level AA for public service sites. Formal legal enforceability, detailed exceptions and effective dates require qualified review.

État de la règle: Non mis en œuvre (squelette vide)
